## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main @ **`ee9ad834`**, the same tree, build and console as the browser slice (record-browser.md): `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, `pnpm console:build`, showcase compiled once; boots `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa3/<batch>/<db>` with `OS_PORT` / `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported, stopped by process group; installs and external-datasource writes from scratch copies; `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages` absent throughout. Ports 41170–41199.
- Special boots: walled `isolated` and `group` (workspace-org-switch); `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE=open` + `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_SELF_REGISTRATION_PERMISSION_SET=member_default` with a local SMTP sink (email-verification-loop); `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=false` (oauth-app-consent-loop off side); a local test OIDC provider registered through a scratch plugin's `applyConfigPatch` (linked-accounts-social — Google itself is reachable through the proxy and answers `401 invalid_client` to a fake client, so the external path is a credentials fixture gap); an in-server clock-offset shim, proved by a stored `created_at` +2 h (sla-escalation); a scratch `create-objectstack` blank scaffold (doctor-deprecation-scan).
- Execution: parallel — 3 runner subagents (effort high), each with its own ports, DBs and browser contexts. No P2 item carries a pin, so every clause was driven or scored blocked/not-run with its reason.
- Timestamps (UTC): runners 05:42–06:42 (P2a 05:42–06:20, P2b 06:08–06:42, P2c 06:20–06:41); setup inside that window ≈ 23 runner-minutes, testing ≈ 76 runner-minutes.

## Scope

Selector `touched:5fb79bc0` at ee9ad834 → 147 runnable items; this record is the 24 unpinned P2 items. Revisions (all equal to the resolver's): route-ledger-live-parity 4 · notification-deep-link 9 · dynamic-approver-routing 6 · ooo-delegation-reroute 7 · record-page-decisions 5 · sla-escalation 4 · flow-toggle-kill-switch 4 · flag-command-error-ux 3 · doctor-deprecation-scan 3 · datasource-introspect-codegen 8 · oauth-app-consent-loop 3 · linked-accounts-social 5 · identity-import-wizard 3 · email-verification-loop 6 · workspace-org-switch 6 · flow-connector-picker 5 · notification-preference-suppression 4 · packaged-object-extend-only 2 · keyboard-shortcut-surface 6 · named-import-mapping 1 · freshness-and-empty 1 · command-palette-navigation 4 · flow-edge-type-authoring 5 · no-entry-property-matrix 8. No `planned` item.

## Derived item verdicts

| verdict | items |

| FAIL (1) | approvals.record-page-decisions (A4, stale spec — re-point card `card-p2-1.md`) |
| PARTIAL (6) | cli.datasource-introspect-codegen (A0 `--schema` narrowing blocked(fixture): SQLite has no schemas; needs a schema-bearing driver) · integration-system.notification-preference-suppression (A3 mandatory-topic half blocked(fixture): the mandatory set is a constructor option) · platform-core.packaged-object-extend-only (N2 not-run: the item's knownGaps say not to stage a collision probe) · platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface (A4 on-page AI-chat half blocked(environment): a stock boot serves no agent catalog) · search.command-palette-navigation (N3 blocked(fixture): no inactive app and never fewer than 3 active apps in the stock seeds) · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix (11 of 37 rows driven, all pass; the rest not-run on budget per knownGaps[3]; QA run #31486 drove 9 others) |
| PASS (17) | every other item |

## Fails — reproduction rule and disposition

**approvals.record-page-decisions · A4** — stale spec. As a contributor-bound member who reads showcase_project `p28JyMGucv-7Y-Yy` but is not a participant of its pending exec_review request: `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/<request id>/approve {}` → expected (clause) 403 FORBIDDEN "is not a pending approver"; actual 404 `{"code":"REQUEST_NOT_FOUND"}`, same on `/reject` and on the action door; the request stays pending. `ApprovalService.refuseUnreadableRequest` answers an unreadable request exactly as a missing id, by design; FORBIDDEN is for a reader with no slot. The rest of A4 held (member's approvals read `[]`, no decision buttons, admin override folding correct). Control probe: a participant re-approving a finalized request answers 409 INVALID_STATE, so the 404 is the read gate, not a blanket 404.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

Each runner kept a probe budget after every item (3–6 min); per-item minutes and doors are in the probe log (record-p2-clauses-1.md). Product defects extracted as card drafts:

| draft | defect | from |
|---|---|---|
| card-p2-2.md | ⌘K "Open Full Search Page" is not findable by its own label words | search.command-palette-navigation |
| card-p2-3.md | approval delegations accept an inverted window and a self-delegation (201, silently inert) | approvals.ooo-delegation-reroute |
| card-p2-4.md | a refused social-link callback (`error=email_does_not_match`) is never shown: the console bounces the signed-in user away | identity-auth.linked-accounts-social |

Observed and not carded (low, for the seat to weigh): a member's project record page logs 404s on `/meta/object/sys_business_unit` and `/sys_comment_reaction` (same class as the known p0 #32955); an SLA `reassign` with no `escalateTo` degrades to notify but its escalate row's comment reads "reassign"; an escalation with `enabled:false` still stamps `sla_due_at`; on the verification boot the seeded, already-verified admin is sent a "verify your email" mail at boot; a named-import Channel value outside the mapping's valueMap ("Fax") passes through unchanged; the identity-import wizard's `auto` result step reports "N created" and never says invitations were sent; a new sign-in session starts on the most recently created organization, not the last one switched to.

## Parked-on #32908

Fixture gaps: a schema-bearing datasource driver for datasource-introspect `--schema`; a mandatory notification topic reachable without a constructor option; an agent catalog for the keyboard-shortcut AI-chat half; an inactive app / single-active-app seed for command-palette N3; real OAuth client credentials for linked-accounts-social's external provider (the local OIDC fixture stood in); a loop in the stock flow fixture for flow-edge-type-authoring's Back-edge step (the runner staged a cycle-closing edge).

Per-item checklist-accuracy notes follow.

**api-backend.route-ledger-live-parity**
- Ledger universe is 16 files at ee9ad834, not eleven (title + fixtures + steps say ELEVEN): new are plugin-audit comment-reaction-route-ledger.ts, plugin-auth personal-view-route-ledger.ts, plugin-sharing sharing-route-ledger.ts, service-messaging messaging-route-ledger.ts, service-print print-route-ledger.ts. Each answered non-404 live; the item's steps/variants should add them.
- REST ledger carries two families not in S0's list: `recycle-bin` (4 rows) and `user-work` (2 rows) — sampled, both 200.
- The cloud-connection ledger read at run time lists 14 route strings in the grep (item says 16 rows across four registrar families) — not re-counted rigorously; sampling only.
- Export capability bit is true while the admin gets 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED on every showcase object tried (task, account, invoice, project): coherent with the admin-export-wildcard removal, but A3's "a bit true ⇒ the family answers" should say "answers (possibly a permission refusal)".

**approvals.notification-deep-link**
- S3/A3 say the component route lands under `com.objectstack.account`. At ee9ad834 the app segment is chosen by the app that owns the request's RECORD (requestPagePath → objectHostAppSegment, objectstack#32667, ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx): an announcement request lands under com.objectstack.setup from BOTH routes (no app's nav lists showcase_announcement), and a showcase_expense_report request (areq_25bb7281…) lands under com.example.showcase. Stale spec wording, not a product defect; the item shou…

**approvals.ooo-delegation-reroute**
- N3's other direction (B forging a row with delegator_id A) answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, not FORBIDDEN: Ada (a demo persona) has no create permission on sys_approval_delegation at all — even for her own delegation (delegate_id A) the POST answers 403 PERMISSION_DENIED. So self-service OOO is not available to that persona on stock seeds; the item's mirror-image design (admin as delegator) is the right one. Recorded as a fact, not scored.

**approvals.record-page-decisions**
- S5/A1/A2 name `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject|approve` as the wire. The record-page bar posts the declared-action door `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_reject|approval_approve` with `recordId` = the request id and the comment under `params.comment`. The clause's substance (one POST, the request's id, comment round-trips) holds; the URL in the item is stale.
- S2 "capture the read the bar ran on: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=…&recordId=…": on first load the page's approvals arrive with `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_project/:id/page`; the GET with object/recordId fires only as the post-decision refresh. Read the viewer block with that GET directly (done here) or from the /page body.
- The member's record page logs two 404s, GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_business_unit and /sys_comment_reaction — same class as the known #32955 (meta/object 404 for non-admins on platform objects); not re-carded, not scored.

**approvals.sla-escalation**
- S1/S2 imply one record can carry every variant; approvals dedupe per record (a second flow on the same record fails `DUPLICATE_REQUEST: a pending approval already exists for showcase_field_zoo/<id>`), and a runtime-authored flow cannot be switched off with /toggle (409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT "the switch turns packaged flows on and off… publish it through PUT /automation/<name> with status 'obsolete'"). Put each variant on its own trigger object (done here: field_zoo / announcement / contact / acco…
- Run detail of the resumed auto_approve/auto_reject runs lists only start > gate steps (end nodes are not logged), so the branch taken is evidenced by the request status, not the run.

**automation.flow-toggle-kill-switch**
- Steps S1/S5/S7 do not name the task fields; showcase_task requires `title`, `project`, `status` (a `subject` key answers 400 INVALID_FIELD). Worth naming in the step.

**cli.flag-command-error-ux**
- Variant list is stale: the item lists 33 variants (20 top-level, 12 topics, g); measured at ee9ad834 is 36 — top-level `deploy` (deploy.ts) and topics `audit` (audit/verify.ts) and `mcp` (mcp/connect.ts) are missing from `variants`. All three were swept and pass.
- Topic-level unknown subcommand prints only "command X not found" with no "See more help with --help" pointer (the flag-error path does print it). A2 does not require a pointer, so not scored.

**cli.doctor-deprecation-scan**
- The 8-entry table yields 9 hits when both retired-lookup spellings are seeded, so the count line reads "Found 9", not 8 — expected, worth a word in the steps.
- A `--skip-install` scaffold makes doctor exit 1 from the `✗ Dependencies Not installed` row, which an A2 reader could misread as the scan gating; the fixture should say deps must be present (I symlinked the showcase's node_modules rather than run an install).

**cli.datasource-introspect-codegen**
- knownGaps[2] / steps[1] are stale: on the stock SQLite fixture `--schema <s>` no longer lists every table — the server/CLI now refuses with "Cannot narrow the remote tables of datasource 'showcase_external': its driver named no schema for 2 of its 2 table(s)." (exit 2). The narrowing half stays unobservable here (blocked(fixture)), but the item should expect the refusal, not an unfiltered listing.
- steps[6] / A5 are stale on validate: `os datasource validate <unknown name>` answers "Datasource \"…\" does not exist." with exit 2, not the vacuous `{ok:true, results:[]}` / "No federated objects to validate." exit 0. The product is stricter than the item; the step should be updated (recorded, not scored, per the step's own instruction).
- A4 wording: a `missing_column` diff prints `✗ missing_column: <object>.<column>` with no expected-vs-actual pair (nothing exists to be "actual") — the clause's "expected vs actual" applies to type/nullability diffs only.
- No sqlite3 CLI in the container; node's built-in `node:sqlite` (DatabaseSync) does the cross-check and the ALTER TABLE.

**identity-auth.oauth-app-consent-loop**
- A measurement trap worth recording in the item: re-presenting an already-exchanged authorization code answers 400 invalid_grant AND revokes every token issued from that code (better-auth's replay cleanup, `deleteIssuedTokens`) — introspect then answers {active:false} and refresh answers 400 "session not found". A run that probes code replay before testing the tokens will think approve minted dead tokens. Measured both ways here: without replay tokens are live; after a replay they are revoked …
- S1 names the console Setup → OAuth Applications create action as one door; this run used the SDK door create-client (allowed by the step). The console door was not driven.
- Cross-user get-consent/delete-consent answer 401 (not 403/404) — a refusal either way; noted only.

**identity-auth.linked-accounts-social**
- The fixture recipe in fixtures.requires[1] works as written at this sha (scratch plugin `start()` → `applyConfigPatch({ oidcProviders })`; the config's own `auth` block is not read by `os dev`). A reusable IdP script would save the next run ~10 min.
- An env door exists for **social** providers (`OS_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET`, settings namespace), but none for `oidcProviders`; Google itself is reachable here, so "external IdP unreachable" is not the blocker — real client credentials are.
- The generic-OAuth sign-in door is `/sign-in/social` with `provider: '<id>'`; `/sign-in/oauth2` answers 404 at this sha.

**identity-auth.identity-import-wizard**
- The `auto` result step shows only "1 created" — it says nothing about the invitation that went out. A0's "the wizard result surfaces both outcomes" is only half-observable: the temporary half has a panel, the invite half is visible only in the API response (rows[].delivery "email") and at the transport. Not scored as a fail (A0's oracle is api), but the item's wording promises a UI surfacing of the invite outcome that the result step does not draw.
- `knownGaps` mentions "dev `log` transport is sufficient to observe" the invite — with the log transport the line carries no link; following the invite (S3) needs the SMTP sink, as used here.

**identity-auth.email-verification-loop**
- The (b)-style boot needs no scratch copy: the auth settings namespace takes env overrides `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE` and `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_SELF_REGISTRATION_PERMISSION_SET` (envKeyOf convention; `member_default` is the showcase's member set). Worth naming in fixtures.requires — it is the cheapest verification boot.
- The mail's link points at the API with `callbackURL=%2F` (`/api/v1/auth/verify-email?token=…&callbackURL=/`), not at the console's `/verify-email` page; S3's "the console's /verify-email consumes ?token=" describes the page, which a run reaches by moving the token onto `/_console/verify-email?token=` as done here. Not scored.

**identity-auth.workspace-org-switch**
- A fresh sign-in session does not resume the session-scoped active org of a previous session: each new browser session of the member started on the most recently created org (Beta), whatever the previous session switched to. A run that expects "the org I switched to last time" will click the current org and see a no-op; pick the target from `get-active-member` first.
- A5's "the UI surfaces an error" has no UI door to drive — the switcher lists only member orgs, so the forged set-active is API-only; the UI half is the post-refusal state (organization picker), recorded above.
- The walled member minted by admin/create-user has almost no write grants in the operator's org (showcase_project create 403, sys_notification_preference 403); the group write probe therefore ran in the member's OWN org (owner) — enough for A3, but S6's "create one row after the switch" needs the target org to be one where the member can write.

**integration-system.flow-connector-picker**
- The shipped flow is not needed: an env-wide POST /api/v1/automation flow opens editable (confirms knownGaps' #23163 measurement at this sha). POST with a blank `connectorId` is refused 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, so the fixture must name a real connector first.
- Two schema facets the typed form deliberately does not render (documented in `connector-input-fields.ts` header): JSON-Schema `required` (echo_upper's `text` shows no asterisk) and slack's `blocks` (array with no items → left to Input/Advanced JSON). Not defects; an author reading A2 literally ("input fields match inputSchema") should know these two are by design.

**integration-system.notification-preference-suppression**
- S5 / A3 spell the admin-global default as `user_id='*'`; that is stale since ADR-0118 D1 — `user_id` is now a sys_user reference and "everyone" is the EMPTY reference. POST with user_id "*" answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reference_not_found ("User: no sys_user record has id \"*\""); omitting user_id stores the global default (`convertWildcardPreferenceUsers` rewrites legacy '*' rows at boot). The item should say "user_id empty".
- A4's hole names: the renderer context exposes `title`, `body`, `topic`, `payload.*` — the notify node's `message` reaches templates as `{{ body }}`. A first attempt with `{{ message }}` rendered empty (unknown path → '' by design), so authors of this step should be told the hole is `body`.
- On a stock boot with the dev log transport the email channel would refuse (isConfigured false); A4 needs the SMTP sink above, same harness as email-verification.

**platform-core.packaged-object-extend-only**
- The /layers read's `code` layer already includes the extension's fields (it is the merged code definition, not the base package's authored definition), so a runner cannot use /layers to show "base untouched, extension separate" — only provenance/lock and overlay:null. Worth a note in S5.

**platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface**
- S3's "exactly … nothing else is listed" inventory is stale: the Navigation group now also lists **Back to home `⌘ ⇧ H`** (`GO_HOME_SHORTCUT`, objectui#12605, AppHeader owns the listener). It is wired — ⌘⇧H and Ctrl+Shift+H both navigate to `/_console/home` — so advertised = wired still holds; the item's step 3 list needs the row added.
- S2 says "a list filter": the stock task list has no always-visible text input; the toolbar Search icon opens one (`placeholder="Search…"`, writes `uf__search`).
- The dialog is mounted only inside app content (`AppContent.tsx`): on `/_console/home` neither `?` nor `?shortcuts=1` opens it, and the Home Help menu correctly offers no "Keyboard shortcuts" entry (no dead affordance). S1's "<any-route>" should read "any app route".

**records-forms.named-import-mapping**
- A Channel value outside the mapping's valueMap ("Fax") passes through verbatim to `source` ("Fax") — the map transform is a partial translation, not a closed set. Not a clause; noted for whoever owns the mapping semantics.

**search.command-palette-navigation**
- S5 names the command 'Dark theme'; the DOM label is "Dark Theme". S6 'Open full search' is labelled "Open Full Search Page". Cosmetic.

**studio-authoring.flow-edge-type-authoring**
- The refused leg sent two publish-drafts POSTs — both mine (the header Publish opens the Pending-changes dialog directly; my script clicked its Publish all, then the dialog's button again after the refusal). Not a double-submit.
- The fixture "Start → Decision → two End nodes" has no loop, so the Back-edge step (S1 "if the flow has one") is skipped by default; staging a normal cycle-closing edge makes Back-edge testable and shows the cycle diagnostic clearing — worth adding to the fixture.

**studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix**
- Row 34: an admin cannot read a draft (or live) dashboard whose requiredPermissions names a capability the admin does not hold (403) — consistent with the AND-gate, but the item's step 0 "GET ?state=draft … confirm stored" needs a holder persona for this row.
- Row 3: "refused … at publish" cannot be reached for an unknown datasource, because the draft save already refuses it; the row should read "at the draft save and the active save".
- A permission set PUT without `objects` is refused 422 (`objects` required even for a systemPermissions-only set) — fixture note for capability-holder sets.
- Row 27's "a failing run carries errorMessage": the trigger response carries it (`error.details.errorMessage`); the run record from /runs carries only the raw `error` — say which surface.

## Per-clause tables

Posted as comments: record-p2-clauses-1…N.md (probe log first). Evidence is text only.
